title: Ulyana and the Harvest
author: Kestrel Lockridge
blurb: Mirabel Ashgrove, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, has spent twenty years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
